changeSet.author: openmrs
changeSet.comment: Create chartsearchai_audit_log table for recording AI chart-search queries. Columns include feedback (rating + comment) and per-request token accounting (input_tokens + output_tokens) — previously layered in via successive changesets that are now collapsed into this create-time definition.

changeSet.author: openmrs
changeSet.comment:
Record how much module-supplied reference material each answer's prompt carried (issue #229): reference_slice_records and reference_slice_chars, beside the existing reference_count, which counts the citations IN the answer rather than the material put in front of the model. Nullable, because null means the producer stated no slice while 0 means the prompt was measured and carried no reference material. Zero says what the prompt carried and not why: a toggle being off, an injection that threw and was caught, and an injection that added only the patient's own active-order records all produce it too.
A new changeset rather than an edit to chartsearchai-002, which is the lifecycle this file's history already shows for a new column: input_tokens/output_tokens arrived as chartsearchai-005 on 2026-04-02 and were folded into 002's create-time definition by the consolidation seven weeks later. Editing 002 now would add nothing on an instance that has already run it, while ChartSearchAuditLog.hbm.xml would declare the columns immediately — so the insert would fail, the controller would swallow it, and auditing would stop with no error anywhere. Fold this into 002 at the next consolidation, once every instance has run it.
Numbered 009 and not 003. Ids 001 to 006 have existed in this file on this branch's own history, and 007 and 008 exist in unmerged branches. Liquibase keys a changeset on id + author + filename AND stores its checksum, so reusing an id an instance holds an orphan row for does not skip quietly — the checksums differ and liquibase raises ValidationFailedException and the module fails to start. Not swallowed, though not surfaced as that type either: ModuleFactory.runLiquibase catches Exception and rethrows ModuleException. Measured on liquibase 4.32.0 (the version openmrs-api puts on this module's classpath) against an instance built from the consolidation-era file, which really does leave orphan rows for 001 and 003. A later merge of the two unmerged branches would collide the same way.
